description: Reads the orders of the app's physical products (products with shipping): "list" or "get" { orderId }. Each has the buyer's name, phone and address (personal data), zone, postage, status, tracking, the EU 14-day withdrawal window after delivery, and refunded (do not ship it). Changes nothing; neblla_orders updates one. More: neblla_get_llms tools/orders_read

action.description: What to read. By action: list {status?, skip?, limit?}; get {orderId}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

name: neblla_orders_read
title: Read shipping orders
